title: Existence of a hard function for small circuit trees
statement: Let $n,S$ be natural numbers satisfying $(n+4)S<2^n$. Then there is a Boolean function on $n$ input bits such that every Boolean circuit tree of size at most $S$ disagrees with it on at least one input.
